name: AreaChart
description: Area chart for change over time where volume matters, stacked by default so the top edge is the total, with a tooltip, keyboard navigation and a table view.

props.title: string (the accessible name; shown above the chart unless titleHidden)
props.description: string (one sentence on what the chart shows; read before it)
props.rows: Record<string, unknown>[] (one object per x value or category)
props.x: { key: string; label?: string; format?: (value: unknown) => string }
props.series: { key: string; label: string; slot?: 1–8; format?: (value: number) => string }[] (one to eight; a ninth is not drawn)
props.y: { label?: string; format?: (value: number) => string; min?: number; max?: number }
props.height: number (plot height in pixels; default 240; width follows the container)
props.legend: auto | hidden (auto shows a legend for two or more series)
props.tableView: boolean (a Show data button swaps the plot for a table of the rows; default true)
props.empty: { title: string; description?: string } (shown when there are no rows)
props.stacked: boolean (default true; without stacking several series draw as lines, because overlapping fills hide each other)

contract.usage: Import { AreaChart } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar/charts. Use it when the series add up to a meaningful total; otherwise use LineChart.
contract.avoid: Do not use status colours or raw colours for series, use two y axes, cycle colours past eight series, copy implementations or override central colours.
contract.accessibility: A named figure with an optional description, a focusable plot whose Left, Right, Home and End keys move a tooltip announced in a live region, a legend so identity never depends on colour, and a Show data table view.
